profiles.name: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail
profiles.description: Saifuddin Nasution Ismail is Minister of Home Affairs. He serves as a senator appointed by the Yang di-Pertuan Agong. He is a member of Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR).

profiles.name: Mohamed Khaled Nordin
profiles.description: Mohamed Khaled Nordin is Minister of Defence. He represents Kota Tinggi, Johor, in the Dewan Rakyat. He is a member of UMNO.

milestones.title: Roll out MyNIISe fully in September 2026
milestones.description: Saifuddin announced full implementation of MyNIISe in September 2026 as part of immigration-system reforms.
milestones.progress_note: The announcement describes preparations and data migration. Full national rollout against this specific September commitment was not established in the reviewed evidence. Status and completion remain unknown; earlier component or project percentages are not substituted for full-rollout evidence.

milestones.title: Restart the PLKN 3.0 pilot in January 2025
milestones.description: Mohamed Khaled announced a PLKN 3.0 trial starting on 12 January 2025, initially describing an intake of 200 participants.
milestones.progress_note: His parliamentary update confirms the pilot began on 12 January with 120 trainees. Achieved covers the restart only: the originally announced 200-person intake is not marked fulfilled. Longer-term training outcomes and sole personal credit are not implied.

methodology: Editorial records of attributable commitments and dated evidence, not endorsements or independently audited performance scores. Promise dates use explicitly stated event dates where available. Year/month-only target dates use end-of-period markers, not an invented exact-day promise. Sector ratios, budget allocations and announcements are not completion scores.
